name: LangChain
summary: Open-source Python and TypeScript framework whose create_agent builds a configurable agent harness from a model, tools, a prompt and middleware.
description: LangChain's docs position it between LangGraph (low-level orchestration) and Deep Agents (batteries-included harness); LangSmith handles tracing and evals. Python package `langchain` 1.4.7 on PyPI (MIT, Python >=3.10); JS/TS lives in langchain-ai/langchainjs (npm `langchain` 1.6.0, MIT). The docs publish an llms.txt and two remote docs MCP servers (see langchain-docs-mcp).
